description: This file defines the AampEventListener class, which is a specialized listener for AAMP playback events within the FireboltMediaPlayer module. It declares event handling methods for various playback-related events and includes references to external classes and event structures.

classes.name: AampEventListener
classes.description: A specialized event listener for handling AAMP media playback events within the FireboltMediaPlayer plugin.

methods.description: Constructor that initializes the listener with a reference to the parent media stream.

methods.description: Destructor for cleaning up the AampEventListener instance.

methods.description: Overrides the base event handler to process incoming AAMP events.
